com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Set up saved review details and editable line references using the invoice's unchanged printed values. Does not approve the invoice or export it. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview initializing saved review metadata and editable line IDs for the invoice we selected, using its unchanged printed values. Wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_initialize_invoice_review, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare creating saved review metadata and durable editable line IDs from unchanged printed source values. Read tools never initialize records. Requires confirmation before the first saved-line edit.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: initialize_invoice_review
title: Initialize editable invoice review
